title: Grade 5 Science — Mon, Jun 01
description: The Skeletal System — Day 1 of 5: Bones and the skeleton
subject: science

questions.question: The framework of bones that supports our body is called the:
questions.explanation: The skeleton is the framework of bones that gives the body its shape and support.

questions.question: About how many bones are there in an adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human body has about 206 bones.

questions.question: The bony box that protects the brain is called the:
questions.explanation: The skull is a hard bony case that protects the soft brain.

questions.question: The set of curved bones that protects the heart and lungs is the:
questions.explanation: The rib cage is made of curved ribs that protect the heart and lungs.

questions.question: The backbone is also called the:
questions.explanation: The backbone, or spine, runs down the middle of the back and supports the body.

questions.question: One important job of the skeleton is to:
options: Give the body shape and support
questions.explanation: The skeleton gives the body its shape and holds it upright.

questions.question: The backbone is made up of many small bones called:
questions.explanation: The backbone is made of small ring-like bones called vertebrae.

questions.question: Besides giving shape, bones also help to:
questions.explanation: Bones protect delicate organs — the skull protects the brain, ribs protect the heart and lungs.

questions.question: Why is the backbone able to bend?
options: It is a single long bone
It is made of many small bones joined together
questions.explanation: The backbone bends because it is made of many small vertebrae joined together.

questions.question: Bones are hard because they contain minerals like:
questions.explanation: Bones are strong and hard because they contain calcium and phosphorus.

questions.question: Which food helps to make our bones strong?
questions.explanation: Milk and dairy products are rich in calcium, which makes bones strong.

questions.question: The longest bone in the human body is found in the:
questions.explanation: The thigh bone (femur) is the longest and strongest bone in the body.

questions.question: If we had no skeleton, our body would:
options: Have no fixed shape and could not stand
questions.explanation: Without a skeleton the body would have no support and could not keep its shape or stand.

questions.question: The skull rests on top of the:
questions.explanation: The skull sits at the top of the backbone (spine).

questions.question: Which statement about the skeleton is TRUE?
options: It is made of soft muscles
It protects organs and supports the body
It only exists in the legs
questions.explanation: The skeleton supports the body, gives it shape and protects important organs.
